toolkits.description: Optional list of toolkit slugs to filter by.

tags.description: Optional Composio action tags to filter by (OR semantics — multiple tags broaden the result, e.g. ["readOnlyHint"] or ["repos", "stars"]). Case-insensitive.

include_unconnected.description: When true, include actions from toolkits the user has not connected yet. Defaults to false (only connected toolkits).
